units.source_text: 他又低声对明石夫人说：“你颇能知情察理，但愿你与紫夫人和睦相处，同心协力地照顾这位女御。”

en.t: He also said softly to Lady Akashi, "You are quite able to understand feelings and judge matters wisely, so I hope you will live in harmony with Lady Murasaki and work together with her to care for this Consort."

units.source_text: 明石夫人答道：“此事不消说得。

en.t: Lady Akashi replied, "That need not even be said.

units.source_text: 我看了紫夫人的慈祥气色，朝夕赞颂，不绝于口呢。

en.t: When I see Lady Murasaki's kindly expression, I praise her morning and evening and can hardly stop speaking of it.

units.source_text: 如果紫夫人把我看作卑贱之人而不容谅我，那么女御也不会如此亲近我了。

en.t: If Lady Murasaki had regarded me as a lowly person and refused to forgive me, then the Consort would never have grown so close to me.

units.source_text: 如今紫夫人对我异常垂青，教我反而觉得不好意思。

en.t: Now Lady Murasaki shows me such extraordinary favor that I instead feel quite embarrassed.

units.source_text: 我这微不足数之人，不自殒灭，活在这世间教女御丢脸，实属不该。

en.t: For someone as insignificant as I am to remain alive in this world instead of disappearing, and thereby bring shame on the Consort, is truly improper.

units.source_text: 全赖紫夫人不加罪责，鼎力庇护……”

en.t: It is entirely because Lady Murasaki does not blame me and has protected me with all her strength..."

units.source_text: 源氏说：“她对你的关怀，倒也算不得特别深切。

en.t: Genji said, "Her concern for you cannot really be called especially deep.

units.source_text: 只因她自己不能常常随伴女御，很不放心，所以将此任务让你担当。

en.t: It is only because she herself cannot always attend the Consort and feels very uneasy that she has entrusted this duty to you.

units.source_text: 你并不明目张胆、以母亲身份独断独行，因此万事圆满顺利，教我心无挂念，不胜欣慰。

en.t: Because you do not openly assert yourself or act arbitrarily in the role of her mother, everything proceeds smoothly and harmoniously, leaving me free of worry and deeply pleased.

units.source_text: 即使区区小事，若有性情乖僻、不通情理之人参与其间，便使得旁人大家为难。

en.t: Even in the smallest matter, if someone with a warped nature and no understanding of reason becomes involved, everyone around them is made to suffer.

units.source_text: 且喜我周围并无此种人物，我大可放心了。”

en.t: Fortunately there is no such person around me, so I can feel quite at ease."

units.source_text: 明石夫人想道：“如此说来，我一向卑躬屈节，终是便宜。”

en.t: Lady Akashi thought, "In that case, my constant humility and restraint have turned out to be to my advantage after all."
